SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.transaction_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'cz' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS recharge_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'tx' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawal_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'fy' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS commission_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'xjfy' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sub_commission_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'zs' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS gift_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'qd' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS signin_amount FROM ( SELECT create_time AS transaction_date, amount AS amount, 'cz' AS type FROM goods_recharge_record WHERE status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT create_time AS transaction_date, amount AS amount, 'tx' AS type FROM order_withdrawal WHERE status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT created_time AS transaction_date, transaction_amount AS amount, transaction_type AS type FROM goods_transaction_flow ) t WHERE t.transaction_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND t.transaction_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.transaction_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

0 END) AS withdrawal_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'commission' THEN t.event_count ELSE 0 END) AS commission_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'sub_commission' THEN t.event_count ELSE 0 END) AS sub_commission_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'gift' THEN t.event_count ELSE 0 END) AS gift_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'signin' THEN t.event_count ELSE 0 END) AS signin_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type =
